topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - Lamp Breathing and Fading Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific breathing or fading rate configuration for the ambient lamp, including its code value, period, and associated original breathing mode.

column_semantics.Code Value: Unique identifier for each breathing/fading rate configuration.
column_semantics.Period: Time duration for one cycle of the breathing/fading effect.
column_semantics.Original Breathing Mode Value: Reference to the original breathing mode that this rate corresponds to.

core_entities.name: UpIPCLampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the breathing rate of the ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: UpIPCLampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command for setting the fading speed of the ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Regional Headlight Zone Control Unit, responsible for processing commands related to lamp breathing and fading.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network bus for communication between modules.

core_entities.name: UpIPAmbtLampC
core_entities.description: Signal sent to control the ambient lamp's breathing or fading behavior.

core_conditions.name: Breathing Rate
core_conditions.description: Defined by the Code Value (0x0 to 0xF), specifying the frequency of the breathing effect.

core_conditions.name: Fading Speed
core_conditions.description: Defined by the Code Value (0x0 to 0xF), specifying the duration of the fading effect.

core_conditions.name: Command Value 0
core_conditions.description: When the command value is 0, the lamp brightness remains unchanged.

core_outputs.name: Lamp Behavior
core_outputs.description: The ambient lamp performs a breathing or fading effect according to the specified rate and mode.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate0
core_timing_constraints.description: No Request; does not trigger any breathing or fading effect.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate1 to Rate15
core_timing_constraints.description: Each rate has a specific period (from 500ms to 12s) defining the speed of the breathing or fading effect.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the mapping between command values and the corresponding breathing/fading rates for the interior ambient lamp. It is used to verify that the RHZCU correctly interprets the UpIPCLampBrthngCmd_1 and UpIPCLampFadeSpdCmd_1 commands and applies the appropriate breathing or fading behavior to the UpIPAmbtLampC output signal.
